host.description: Ticketing, marketing and operations platform for live events: festivals, club nights, concerts, conferences and tours.

entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for managing events, ticket types, orders and sales. It ships inside the Ticket Fairy command-line tool (npm install -g ticketfairy) and runs locally over stdio. The linked document names the package, the command and the transport.
representativeQueries: connect my AI assistant to Ticket Fairy
create an event and its ticket types on Ticket Fairy
check how many tickets my event has sold
does Ticket Fairy have an MCP server

entries.description: Universal Commerce Protocol profile listing the protocol version and the commerce services currently available to agents on this domain.
representativeQueries: does Ticket Fairy support Universal Commerce Protocol
which UCP commerce services can I use on Ticket Fairy

entries.description: Agentic Commerce Protocol profile listing the protocol version and the commerce services currently available to agents on this domain.
representativeQueries: does Ticket Fairy support Agentic Commerce Protocol
which ACP commerce services can I use on Ticket Fairy

entries.description: Short llmstxt.org index of what the platform does, who it suits, how it is priced and where it operates, with a link for anything deeper.
representativeQueries: what does Ticket Fairy do
which ticketing platform should I use for a festival
how much does Ticket Fairy charge to sell tickets

entries.description: The same catalogue in full: every capability described in a paragraph, for an agent answering a detailed question about the platform.
representativeQueries: does Ticket Fairy support RFID wristbands and cashless payments
which payment methods and countries does Ticket Fairy support
how does Ticket Fairy stop ticket scalping
can I sell tickets from my own website with Ticket Fairy

entries.description: Sitemap index covering every listed event, city guide, venue guide and page on the platform, split into per-country files. Each page it names also answers in Markdown: add .md to its URL, or send Accept: text/markdown.
representativeQueries: list every event on sale on Ticket Fairy
find live music events in a particular city
which festivals still have tickets available
where is the full catalogue of Ticket Fairy events

entries.description: Find public events through the Model Context Protocol and follow event links to continue in browser checkout. No account is required to search.
representativeQueries: find public events on Ticket Fairy
search for live music events in my city
find the event page where I can buy tickets
